column1: # Shared map: gopass entry <TAB> 1Password reference used in secrets.json.tpl.
# Read by render-secrets --from gopass (fills the template) and by
# Names and references only. No values. A template reference that is not listed
# here is left out of the rendered file on purpose (for example the 1Password
# service-account token, which no longer exists in the template).
# An optional third column "required" marks a row whose absence must fail the
# render (it guards something that fails open without it, such as the Syncthing
# GUI login). RENDER_SECRETS_ALLOW_MISSING=1 overrides that for a bootstrap.
